subject: Important Evaluation - Tell Us About Leo Sterling's Program Today

messages.subject: Important Evaluation - Tell Us About Leo Sterling's Program Today
messages.body:
Dear Marcus Vance,

Thank you for joining Wilderness Quest today! Feedback helps us create our adventures. We need your help. Take a moment to share your family's story with us. These evaluations are very important.

Two-Minute Check-In: https://new.wildernessquest.org/surveys/new

Feedback How-To:
- We use this daily insight to be flexible to the needs of our student community.
- Feedback is how we collaborate, helping co-create better experiences for every student.
- Both appreciative and constructive feedback inform our staff of what to do more or less.

The Wilderness Quest Staff thanks you for your appreciations, constructives, and feedback! For any immediate inquiries or needs, reach out to (800) 555-0142 or contact@havenside.example.

See You In The Forest,

Family Success
